attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his signed newsletter post.

semantics.note: Keeps the hedged 'likely' build estimate and the flat 'never happening' forecast. Only the categorical non-delivery part can be scored. The 'does not exist' part was true when written, since delivery starts early 2027.

contract.note: Treats the flat parenthetical as the scored forecast and ties it to the March 2026 agreement. The early-resolution triggers (verified delivery or termination) are a fair, ordinary reading. No deadline was given, so the horizon is open.

evidence.note: Nebius's own announcement says delivery starts early 2027. That is a promise, not delivery or termination.
Shows $3.75B was the proposed size, later upsized. It bears on the financing description, not on the capacity forecast.
The closing release confirms about $4.34B principal raised. It does not show the Meta deal was the sole cause or say anything about delivery.
The August company letter says the buildout is on track for early 2027. That is progress, not commissioned delivery.

reviews.rationale: The categorical 'never happening' forecast has no deadline. By the evaluation date the packet shows neither verified delivery under the March 2026 Meta agreement nor its termination. Nebius's own disclosures still place delivery in early 2027, and those are not independent findings. Neither the support nor the contradiction condition is met.

attribution.note: Zitron's own estimate in his signed post.

semantics.note: A present-tense estimate of aggregate absorption time. The 'about 6 months' threshold is preserved.

contract.note: Mapping 'now' to NVIDIA's latest fiscal quarter and reading the claim as an aggregate absorption rate is a fair, ordinary reading. It needs matched shipment and deployment data.

evidence.note: The 10-K says geographic revenue follows customer headquarters, not install location. This weakens the geographic conversion but does not measure absorption time.
CBRE net absorption is a measure of leasing and occupancy for 2025. It is not operational NVIDIA GPU throughput for the target quarter.

reviews.rationale: The packet has no matched data on GPU shipments and operational deployment. Revenue split by customer headquarters and property-market absorption figures cannot confirm or rule out an absorption time of about six months for the target quarter. The evidence does not settle the claim.
